balanced.description: Helpful first, with Béa's dry humor mixed in.

helpful.description: Clear, useful and calm, with very light personality.

funny.description: Dog puns, self-deprecation and playful comments.

sassy.description: Dry, sarcastic and mildly judgmental about the situation — never the user.

quiet.description: Mostly status text, with almost no jokes.

toneRules.helpful: Give useful, reassuring status language. Avoid filler.
toneRules.funny: Use dog puns, tiny-leg jokes, self-deprecation and playful absurdity.
toneRules.sassy: Use dry sarcasm about results, maps, options or Béa herself. Never insult or shame the user.
toneRules.encouraging: Keep it warm and positive without sounding overly enthusiastic.

selectionRules: Select from the current action's prompt bank first.
Then sample a tone according to the user's selected personality weights.
Avoid repeating any of the last 5 shown lines.
Do not change the line more often than every 4.2 seconds.
For errors, destructive actions, payments or safety-critical states, do not use jokes.
Ball and bone lines are Easter eggs and should remain uncommon even in Funny mode.
